text:
noah (product): quick ask from enterprise AE - customers want explicit guarantees for legal-hold exports: timeline, manifest fields, and key handling. can we lock down a minimal spec today?

li (eng): propose minimal retention buckets: live-search=30d, warm=180d, archive=7y. exports must include `retention_bucket` per object and `object_sha256`. Add `legal_hold_id` + `issued_by` to every export manifest. We'll emit manifest_v1 next to bundles.

maria (security): SOC2 requirements: signed manifest + checksum per object, signing key fingerprint, and chain-of-custody: requester_email, signing_ts, and signer_audit_id. For BYOK, include `customer_keystore_id` and `kms_key_version`. If customer refuses escrow, require customer verification key for signature verification.

kelly (legal): need API to pin records (indefinite) and an `override_ticket_id`. Legal expects targeted export within 48h and full scoped export within 10d. Also need human-readable `legal_hold.reason` and `issued_at`.

sam (ops): operational notes: exports are heavy. plan: export queue with per-tenant throttling, `exports.priority` flag, and a dashboard card for "pending legal exports". Canary: 4 tenants 72h -> 20% 5d -> full. Estimate storage +10% for manifest & key history.

li (eng): example manifest snippet:
```json
{"manifest_version":"1","legal_hold_id":"lh_2026","tenant_id":"t_99","requested_by":"legal@acme.com","issued_at":"2026-02-12T14:00:00Z","objects":[{"path":"s3://redwood/exports/t99/part-0001.gz","sha256":"...","size":12345,"retention_bucket":"search"}],"signatures":[{"signer":"redwood-hsm-v2","fingerprint":"ab:cd:ef","sig":"base64..."}],"kms_key_id":"proj/tn99/key","kms_key_version":"v2"}
```

maria (security): acceptance tests: produce 3 signed exports (one BYOK w/ customer key, one BYOK no-escrow, one standard). security must validate signatures and checksums within 24h during canary.

noah (product): decisions needed by EOD Thu: (1) confirm manifest fields, (2) sign-off on SLAs (48h/10d), (3) key metadata retention window (propose 3 years), (4) canary cadence. I'll draft RFC and add to INF backlog.

release-bot: ticket INF-4120 created and placed in next sprint milestone.

noah (product): thanks team - please drop any objections inline. I will post RFC link once drafted.
